title: Affine differential sections map is injective
statement: Under the hypotheses of the affine differential sections map, any compatible linear map is injective.

proof.text: Use relativeDifferentials_affine_chart_derivation to obtain the specified affine-chart isomorphism T and its inverse formula on universal differentials. Take global sections of T inverse and compose with relativeDifferentialsSpecΓHom for the affine ring map. Transport sections back to U using restrictAppIso and the equality fromSpec image top = U. This gives a linear map C from ring differentials to sheaf sections.

Compute C(d a) using relativeDifferentialsSpecΓHom_d, the inverse formula for T, naturality of the sheaf derivation, and ΓSpecIso_inv_map_appIso_inv. The two restriction maps compose to the identity, so C(d a) = d a. The supplied map e has this same value by hypothesis. Apply CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.ext to conclude e = C.

The section transport L is injective: apply restriction in the other direction to L(z) = L(w), cancel the restriction maps, and use injectivity of restrictAppIso hom. Both relativeDifferentialsSpecΓHom and the global-sections map of T inverse are isomorphisms, hence injective. Their composite with L is injective. Since e equals that composite, e is injective.
